# robots.txt for https://hax.psu.edu/
#
# AI assistants and agents: a plain-text guide to this site is at
#   https://hax.psu.edu/llms.txt       (link map + key facts)
#   https://hax.psu.edu/llms-full.txt  (full homepage content as Markdown)
# and curated HAX agent skills are indexed at
#   https://hax.psu.edu/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json

# hax.psu.edu exists to be discovered: every major search engine, AI search
# / answer engine, user-initiated assistant fetcher and AI training crawler is
# welcome here. (HAX sites on other hax.psu.edu subdomains set their own rules.)
# Listing them explicitly documents that intent; the rules match the
# catch-all group below.
User-agent: Googlebot
User-agent: Google-Extended
User-agent: Bingbot
User-agent: Applebot
User-agent: Applebot-Extended
User-agent: DuckDuckBot
User-agent: DuckAssistBot
User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
User-agent: ClaudeBot
User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
User-agent: Claude-User
User-agent: PerplexityBot
User-agent: Perplexity-User
User-agent: CCBot
User-agent: Meta-ExternalAgent
User-agent: Amazonbot
User-agent: MistralAI-User
Allow: /
Disallow: /login.php
Disallow: /webhook.php
Disallow: /stats/

# Everyone else.
User-agent: *
# Content Signals (https://contentsignals.org): search, AI answers and AI
# training are all explicitly permitted. Crawlers that don't know this line
# ignore it.
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=yes
Allow: /
Allow: /llms.txt
Allow: /llms-full.txt
Allow: /.well-known/
# Rendering assets: crawlers that execute JS (Googlebot, Bingbot) need these
# to see the page the way people do.
Allow: /assets/*.css$
Allow: /assets/*.css?
Allow: /assets/*.js$
Allow: /assets/*.js?
Allow: /assets/*.gif
Allow: /assets/*.jpg
Allow: /assets/*.jpeg
Allow: /assets/*.png
Allow: /assets/*.webp
Allow: /assets/*.avif
Allow: /assets/*.svg
Allow: /assets/*.ico
Disallow: /assets/
Disallow: /login.php
Disallow: /webhook.php
Disallow: /stats/
Disallow: /build/
Disallow: /dist/
Disallow: /node_modules/
